title: Convergence of a Newton algorithm for semi-discrete optimal transport
tldr_zh: 半离散 OT 阻尼 Newton 法全局线性、局部 1+α 阶收敛，条件为 MTW 型代价 + 源密度加权 Poincaré–Wirtinger
tldr_en: Damped Newton for semi-discrete OT converges globally linearly and locally at rate 1+alpha under Loeper/MTW cost condition and a weighted Poincare-Wirtinger inequality on the source.
key_numbers: Thm 1.5: global linear + local rate 1+alpha convergence of damped Newton (Sec. 1.7)
Thm 5.1: <D^2 Phi(psi) v|v> <= -C eps^3 ||v||^2 on K_eps x E_Y (Sec. 5)
Prop. 6.1: residual contracts by (1 - tau_k/2), tau_k = min(kappa^{1+1/alpha} eps/(d^{1/alpha} L^{1/alpha} ||G-mu||), 1) (Eq. 6.47)
Prior coordinate-increment methods need N^3/eps iterations (Sec. 1)
Numerical example: piecewise-linear density on [0,3]^2 with hole, 30^2 grid target, 25 Newton iterations to machine precision (Sec. 6.3)
